subject: a clear transparent pressed glass tumbler you can see straight through, smooth rounded vertical panels, one faint straight mould seam line down one side, plain flat surface, no facets
positive: Editorial still-life photograph, a clear transparent pressed glass tumbler you can see straight through, smooth rounded vertical panels, one faint straight mould seam line down one side, plain flat surface, no facets. One single warm tungsten light source from the low left, about 3200K, casting one long soft shadow with gentle falloff across a deep espresso-brown matte ground, low-key exposure, most of the frame in soft shadow. Muted desaturated colour grade, matte surfaces, no gloss, no reflections. Shallow depth of field, 85mm macro lens, fine film grain, quiet luxury interior magazine photography. Empty frame, only the object. No people, no hands, no text.
